title: Locale UI strings
description: The words the site itself says in one language, as opposed to the words of the story. Every locale in text/locales.json must have this file in full: a language may be behind on chapters, but the chrome around the story cannot be half translated. Keys are added only when something on screen needs them; see docs/text-pipeline.md.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; not part of the data.

locale.description: Must equal the directory name, so a copied file cannot silently claim another language.

partPending.description: Shown beside a part this language has no text for yet, on the story entry.

localePartial.description: Shown beside a language on the home page when some of its parts can be read and some cannot.

localeNone.description: Shown beside a language on the home page when none of its parts can be read yet.
